name: structure-viewer
description: Read-only structure viewer with switchable themes, on-demand MD trajectories, atom selection and native snapshot export.

interface.shortDescription: 原子结构与轨迹查看、选择与测量
interface.longDescription: Open POSCAR, CONTCAR and XDATCAR by their original paths through the Structure Viewer thread tab, locally or on the connected remote host. Open LAMMPS trajectories with companion files, GROMACS GRO, ASE trajectories, XYZ/extxyz, PDB and CIF. Includes element visibility, box selection, measurements and snapshots.
